description:
Activate Enclave Cryptologist by tapping it, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures twice.
Repeat.

uses.name: Enclave Cryptologist
uses.cardState: is level 1 or 2 and does not have summoning sickness
